reserves.issuerOrObligor: Gate and undisclosed Treasury, stablecoin, and custody counterparties

sources.label: Gate GUSD minting and RWA help article (2026-06-11; reviewed 2026-08-17)

reserveReview.rationale: Gate's current product page calls GUSD a principal-protected flexible-term investment product backed by tokenized Treasury bills and stablecoins, while also saying returns come from Gate ecosystem revenue, Treasury RWAs, and stablecoin-backed yield assets. These statements describe backing and return sources at a category level only. Gate publishes no token-specific holdings schedule, allocation, named reserve vehicle, custodian list, or independent reserve-to-issued-token reconciliation. Its exchange proof-of-reserves materials publish customer and platform GUSD balances, which evidence custody of customer GUSD tokens rather than the assets backing all issued GUSD. Accepted subscription assets (USDT, USDC, and USD1) are minting inputs and are not treated as reserve weights. Composition therefore remains one explicit 100% known-unknown basket.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Gate GUSD product and help disclosures; Gate exchange proof-of-reserves materials reviewed only to distinguish customer-token custody from product backing
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Gate does not publish current backing weights, instrument identities, reserve-vehicle terms, custody providers, legal segregation, or a product-specific reconciliation of issued GUSD to backing assets.

providers.name: Gate and undisclosed tokenized-asset or stablecoin custodians

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Gate does not identify the GUSD legal reserve vehicle, backing-asset custody providers, provider shares, segregation model, bankruptcy remoteness, or rehypothecation terms. Its exchange proof-of-reserves page concerns customer-asset custody and does not fill those product-specific gaps.
